(minion_spawn_913, holding at wayB0 beside the key): the knight goes through, comes out at (100, 195) over the
empty column and falls (994). A portal at (240, 20) over the key's ledge and one on the player: left to

it down (1144). Right along the corridor to x 381; a portal at (440, 125) over the octagon block (6 units over

the player; right: the key opens keyhole_1338, door_locked_ent_1343 goes, and into the door. Leans on G1

(ETHCallback_minion walks toward its waypoint's x with no floor probe: its one ray, #943, is the sight

Re-authored on wave 3a's timing build (R3, round 1): each shot flies 3.2 px a tick after a 24-unit jump
(G4), so a shot waits for the one before it to land (113, 499, 950, 988, 1430, 1502), each next tap two ticks
after the landing, and the 400 ms is 26 ticks; the player walks 144 u/s (G10), so every walk is shorter. The
taps at (232, 30), (440, 125) and (530, 100) wait for the camera to settle (the aim drifts under 0.25 px).
Knight C walks to the column on its own clock and falls on tick 454 whatever tick the lift is touched between
240 and 345. Won on tick 1663. Every tap and walk edge 3 ticks either way wins (bar the later side of a shot
whose follower waits on its landing, and the earlier side of a follower held by the 26 ticks).
